scope: Independent read-only kernel-semantics review for namespace creating-thread lifetime; no compilation, kernel change, device change or production claim.

findings.evidence: fs/pidfs.c pidfd_poll does not inspect PIDFD_THREAD; readiness requires task->exit_state && !delay_group_leader(task). delay_group_leader is thread_group_leader && !thread_group_empty. A dead leader with a living sibling can remain unreadable.
PIDFD_INFO_EXIT is returned only after PIDFS_ATTR_BIT_EXIT is published by pidfs_exit. pidfs_exit is called from release_task; delayed leader release occurs after the other group members exit.

PR_SET_PDEATHSIG takes tasklist_lock for read. exit_notify takes it for write around forget_original_parent, setting EXIT_ZOMBIE and notifications. An after-arm fresh bound-task stat read can observe early death when the pidfd itself remains unreadable.
PF_EXITING is 0x00000004. do_exit calls exit_signals before exit_files and exit_notify; exit_signals sets the bit under sighand siglock.

The proc inode retains get_task_pid(task, PIDTYPE_PID); reads use that held struct pid via proc_single_show and get_pid_task rather than re-looking up a numeric TID. A missing task returns ESRCH. State and task->flags are not masked by the ptrace permission decision; flags is stat field 9.
seq_read_iter resets index/count for offset zero before re-running the show operation. pread64(offset=0) after parent-side validation does not reuse a stale alive snapshot.

proposed_fix_review_requirements: Keep the true thread pidfd and add a creation-time read-only held proc thread-stat FD; never reopen a numeric TID path in the raw child.
Pin all three source FDs above 5 before cloning; remap 3/4/5 without source clobber; close fd5 after its final credential rearm check.

Fresh raw pread64(offset0), fixed-size buffer, complete parsing with comm parentheses/whitespace and checked decimal parsing; reject Z/X/PF_EXITING, identity mismatch, read error or malformed/truncated data.

Actual leader and non-leader before-arm and before-rearm controls, plus fresh real credential mapping and nested-tree/empty-base controls; do not treat the non-leader-only tests as arbitrary-thread coverage.
